      "snippet": "That message is almost certainly infrastructure-side, not a MetaBlooms or OS-logic failure.
Here’s what’s going on and what to do next.

What the error actually means
“The server is having problems, try again later” is thrown when one of these happens:

Backend overload / restart

The model backend or file service is restarting or throttling.

This is common after:

Large ZIP creation

Many rapid tool executions

High I/O turns (which you just did)

Transient file-service timeout
